loop_join: The final beat p14, short300_14.png, shows the town now -- a rebuilt two-lane street under flat overcast sky -- rewound under the FULL CASE card and held to the last frame. On repeat the file cuts from that rebuilt street back to frame 0, short300_01.png, the hose coupling with only a thin stream of water, so the loop closes the film's own before/after: the town restored, then straight back to the failing water pressure the short is about.
second_watch_detail: p04 shows an excavated trench exposing an intact water main -- on a first watch it reads as generic infrastructure B-roll. Once L6 and L7 explain that the pressure loss came from a thousand open taps inside burning houses rather than a broken main, that same trench, dug open for inspection and clearly not the point of failure, is the film quietly showing you the one thing that was proven NOT broken.
